notes.critical_fix_verified: The DocumentActionsBar badge fix is working perfectly. autoCheckSignature=false successfully prevents N+1 signature fetch when AR Receipt list loads (initial badge count = 0). After user signs a document, loadSignature(force) is called and the badge appears immediately (badge count increased to 1) without requiring page refresh. This solves the performance issue while maintaining UX.
notes.backend_status: All backend APIs are fully functional. PDF rendering works for all required document types (transfer, cycle_count, ar_receipt, sales_order, purchase_order) in both PDF and HTML formats. E-Sign flow complete (request OTP, verify, public verify, get signatures). WhatsApp endpoints work correctly in simulation mode. WhatsApp rules CRUD operations working.
notes.frontend_status: All frontend flows tested and working. Transfer and Cycle Count modules correctly show DocumentActionsBar without E-Sign button (esignable=false). AR Receipt module shows all buttons including E-Sign (esignable=true). Preview modals open correctly with iframe. WhatsApp modal displays with auto-filled phone number, simulation mode warning, and delivery history.
notes.mocked_apis: WhatsApp send returns 'simulated' status (by design, no Meta credentials required). E-Sign OTP uses simulation channel (OTP returned in response via 'reveal_code' field: 030233).
notes.regression_testing: This iteration verified that all previous functionality remains intact after the badge fix implementation. No regressions detected.
